Attribution: Wikidata contributors (structured data under CC0), DBpedia maintainers and Wikipedia contributors.
Sources: https://www.wikidata.org/ and https://dbpedia.org/
Wikidata licensing: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Wikidata:Licensing
DBpedia resource pages display their source attribution and CC BY-SA 4.0 license.

This educational dataset selects, normalizes, and links source records. Original responses,
URLs, retrieval timestamps and SHA-256 hashes are retained in data/raw/ and its manifest.
The public dataset does not reproduce long source articles or film artwork.
When redistributing adaptations of this combined dataset, keep attribution and this license.
